sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor Mr.Kodekar waives service of Rule on behalf of the respondent - State.
2. By way of this application, the applicant prays for being released on parole leave for the purpose of providing financial assistance to his family.

3. Jail remarks show that applicant had been convicted for the offences punishable under Section 376(d) of the Indian Penal Code amongst others and under the provisions of POCSO Act and sentenced to life- imprisonment.
It also appears that up till now, the applicant has undergone approximately 5 years and 10 months of incarceration.

It also appears that the applicant had been released twice on temporary bail and once on parole leave and whereas it appears that except on one occasion, the applicant had surrendered late on two occasions.

sentences.text: 1 4. Considering the said aspect and having regard to the period of incarceration the applicant has already undergone, while this Court is inclined to allow this application, yet appropriate safeguards are required to be imposed.

The applicant is directed to be released on parole leave for a period of 15 days from the date of actual release on executing personal bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) before the Jail authority and on usual terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Jail Authority.
The applicant shall mark his presence before the Borsad Town Police Station on the 5th and 10th day of his release.
5. The applicant convict to surrender before Jail Authority on completion of parole leave, without fail.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Registry is directed to communicate this order to the concerned Jail Authority by fax / email message forthwith.
